records.translation: OPS 聚类：扫描背景中的对照行

records.source: Count the run's own control rows (non-targeting guides) in the Fisher background of the CORUM and KEGG shares of spaCR's sweep rows, as the published comparators count theirs, so every row of the sweep table uses one background. They are never cluster members or STRING pairs, and the STRING and complex metrics do not change. Off by default (maintainer decision): the sweep rows keep the targeting-only background they had before item 959. Default False. Alpha.
records.translation: 将本次运行自身的对照行（非靶向向导）计入 spaCR 扫描行 CORUM 和 KEGG 比例的 Fisher 背景，与已发表比较基准计入其自身对照行的方式相同，使扫描表中每一行都使用同一背景。它们从不作为聚类成员或 STRING 基因对，STRING 和复合物指标不变。默认关闭（维护者决定）：扫描行保留项目 959 之前仅含靶向基因的背景。默认值 False。Alpha。
